OpenBotUrl.title: OpenBot address
OpenBotUrl.description: The HTTPS address of your organization's OpenBot. The Recorder connects only to this address. Chrome ignores a value that is not a string, so check that chrome://policy shows it with no error.

AllowedIntelligenceUrls.title: Allowed Intelligence addresses
AllowedIntelligenceUrls.description: WSS addresses of your Intelligence realtime gateway, as a list. The Recorder refuses a capture pass that points anywhere else. Chrome ignores a value that is not a list of strings (on Windows, numbered values under a subkey, or one JSON list), and an ignored value means no restriction, so check that chrome://policy shows it with no error.
